MARKET OVERVIEW
The consumer durables market navigated a challenging quarter, with part of the festive 
demand this year shifting to November. At the same time, rising commodity costs and 
adverse forex movements are putting pressure on margins. However, the continued 
consumer preference for higher capacity products and feature rich models offers an 
opportunity to drive premiumisation , improve average selling prices and support 
profitable growth.
Strategic Focus Areas
Cost and Portfolio Optimisation : We continue to drive cost efficiencies to partially offset 
the commodity and forex impact. SKU 
rationalisation and portfolio optimisation has 
helped to reduce complexities and increase focus on identified key products. 
Premiumisation and Customer Experience: Leverage demand for feature rich 
appliances and superior ownership experiences to drive value growth and strengthen 
customer loyalty.

Washers
In Q2 FY 27, the Front Load market continued its shift towards higher capacity washing machines, with the segment 
growing by approximately 40 % . IFB continues to strengthen its position in this segment through differentiated 
premium offerings including Smart and Auto Dosing technology and premium aesthetics . We will continue to build 
on this momentum with a strategic focus on higher capacities and innovation led technologies to drive 
premiumisation , improve realisation and strengthen competitive differentiation.
The Top Load category is also witnessing a similar shift towards higher capacity washing machines . IFB is 
strengthening its proposition in this segment through premium features such as Steam, Inverter technology and 
Wi-Fi connectivity, offering consumers enhanced convenience and performance . Our strategy is to create a 
compelling value proposition that combines higher capacity, differentiated features and premium aesthetics to 
drive consumer preference and improve product mix. 
Air Conditioners
The strategic focus in Q3 & Q4 will be to continue to accelerate premiumisation, increase placement / market 
penetration and grow the contribution of high end ACs including the hot
-and-cold product.

focusing on its Premium Air Fry Microwave portfolio. We are strengthening our presence in the premium solo 
segment with the launch of the 32L Solo Microwave. We will be upgrading our existing 20L and 24L Solo models 
with enhanced aesthetics to drive differentiation and 
to strengthen our competitive positioning.

Home Appliances Division 
Every IFB Front Load Washing Machine now offers consumers the flexibility to wash 
and refresh garments in a single appliance, extending fabric care beyond 
conventional washing & reinforcing its differentiated fabric care positioning.
Having established the 2 -in-1 Washer Refresher proposition in the previous quarter, 
our focus this quarter will be towards educating consumers about garment 
refreshing and its relevance in everyday fabric care. Built around the insight that not 
every garment needs washing after every wear, the proposition encourages 
consumers to refresh lightly worn clothes instead of subjecting them to repeated 
wash cycles, helping conserve water, detergent and fabric quality.
The festive season presents a strong opportunity to bring this proposition to life. 
With a key visual showcasing festive garments being refreshed inside an IFB Front 
Load Washing Machine, our festive communication will center around “Refresh Your 
Festive Wear with IFB.”

contemporary design. 
The premium Inverter range has gained traction within six months of its introduction, 
contributing 41% of Top Load sales. This reflects increasing consumer acceptance of IFB's 
premium offerings and reinforces the brand's strategy of driving growth through differentiated 
technology, contemporary design and a stronger premium product mix.
The shift towards higher capacity washing machines continues to gain momentum, with the 
contribution of the above 8 Kg segment this year more than doubling as compared to the 
same time last year. This significant improvement highlights IFB's progress in strengthening its 
higher capacity portfolio. 
IFB aims to further strengthen its premium positioning by expanding the above 10 Kg portfolio 
and targeting Wi -Fi enablement across the range. This focus on larger capacities, intelligent 
connectivity and contemporary design will reinforce IFB's positioning in the evolving smart Top 
Load Washing Machine segment.

Driving H2 growth through demand readiness, product differentiation and profitability enhancement
1. Sales Performance & H2 Outlook
Q2 initiatives focused on accelerating volume growth and capturing off-season demand . H2 focus would be on 
sustaining the sales momentum, leveraging the seasonally stronger demand period for air conditioners . Early 
demand indicators point towards a potentially strong upcoming season .
2. Product Differentiation & Premiumisation
Enhanced RAC range designed to deliver both cooling & heating performance at ambient temperatures between 
52°C and -15°C, positioning IFB in the heavy duty all-weather segment . Introduction of 3-Star, 4-Star and 5-Star 
variants, alongside advanced technologies such as AI Climate Control and Direct Voice Command .
3. Channel Effectiveness & Execution
Improve dealer stock availability and adherence to the planned product mix. Strengthen retail visibility and 
product demonstrations to improve consumer engagement and conversion .
4. Profitable Growth & Operational Discipline
Drive cost efficiencies to protect margins . Improve contribution through an improved product mix and increased 
focus on higher value categories .
